note: Hockley County does not zone; the City of Levelland (largest city) zones its land and publishes a zoning map page and a Public Interactive Web Map, but no queryable ArcGIS REST or download service of zoning districts was found in the city pages or ArcGIS Online searches (the city pages returned 404 to my reader). Levelland's Municipal and Collection layers on ArcGIS Online hold no zoning polygons. Hockley CAD parcel viewer and Regrid have no district layer.
